title: Referrals and Authorizations Schedule of Units and Validity Spans by Authorization Type
content:
Every referral or authorization issued under **Referrals and Authorizations** carries two separate limits: a balance of authorized units, counted in the unit of its type, and a validity span measured in calendar days. The figures below are fixed for each authorization type.

## Schedule A. Units and spans

| Authorization type | Unit counted | Units on a standard approval | Most units one authorization may carry, extensions included | Validity span, in calendar days, counting the first day as day 1 | First day of the span | Most units one service date may use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Specialty Care Referral | visits | 6 | 12 | 180 | the date of approval | 1 |
| Rehabilitative Therapy Referral | visits | 12 | 36 | 90 | the date of approval | 1 |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | rental months | 13 | 13 | 395 | the date of approval | 1 |
| Home Health Care Authorization | visits | 30 | 120 | 60 | the date of approval | 2 |
| Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization | hours | 480 | 480 | 180 | the date of approval | 8 |
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization | inpatient days | 14 | 98 | 14 | the admission date | 1 |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization | inpatient days | 7 | 37 | 7 | the admission date | 1 |

## Schedule B. What one unit used means

| Authorization type | One unit used is |
|---|---|
| Specialty Care Referral | one visit per date of service with the servicing provider |
| Rehabilitative Therapy Referral | one visit per date of service with the servicing provider |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | one rental month per monthly rental claim line |
| Home Health Care Authorization | one visit per home visit |
| Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization | one hour per hour of direct or supervision service |
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization | one day per inpatient day, the discharge day excluded |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization | one day per inpatient day, the discharge day excluded |

## Reading the schedule

- The span column counts the first day of the span as day 1, so the last day of the span is the first day plus the span length, less one day.
- "Units on a standard approval" and "most units one authorization may carry" are different figures for most types; for the Durable Medical Equipment Authorization and the Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization the two are the same (13 rental months; 480 hours).
- The service-date column caps what a single date of service can use: a Home Health Care Authorization may use up to 2 visits on one date, an Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization up to 8 hours, every other type 1 unit.

## Worked spans (hypothetical first days)

| Hypothetical case | First day | Span length | Last day of the span |
|---|---|---|---|
| Specialty Care Referral approved on 2 March 2026 | 2 March 2026 | 180 days | 28 August 2026 |
| Rehabilitative Therapy Referral approved on 2 March 2026 | 2 March 2026 | 90 days | 30 May 2026 |
| Home Health Care Authorization approved on 2 March 2026 | 2 March 2026 | 60 days | 30 April 2026 |
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization, admission on 2 March 2026 | 2 March 2026 | 14 days | 15 March 2026 |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization, admission on 2 March 2026 | 2 March 2026 | 7 days | 8 March 2026 |

The dates in these rows are illustrations only; the spans themselves are the schedule figures.
